en.connection.title: Server connection
en.connection.hint: Set the image server address to browse and manage images and complete prompts.

en.connection.status.unconfigured: No server address is configured. The library is not connected.

en.connection.status.forbidden: The server denied access (403). Check this account’s library permissions.
en.connection.status.route-missing: The library API path was not found (404). Check the service address and server route.

en.connection.status.timeout: The server connection timed out. Library availability has not been confirmed. Try again.
en.connection.status.unreachable: A server connection could not be established. Check the network, address and security certificate.
en.connection.status.invalid-response: The server did not return valid library data. The connection is unverified. Check the address and service.
en.connection.status.invalid-config: The saved connection configuration cannot be read. Check the app configuration file or contact the administrator.
en.connection.status.invalid-address: The server address is invalid. Enter an HTTPS address including the service path.
en.connection.status.environment: The server address is set by startup configuration and cannot be changed here.
en.connection.status.failed: The library connection could not be verified. Check the server settings and retry.
en.connection.signedOut: Signed out of the platform. Sign in again before connecting to the library.
en.connection.status.session-expired: The platform session has expired. Sign in again, then connect to the library.
en.connection.status.not-initialized: The platform administrator is not initialized. Ask the server administrator to run the secure initialization command locally on the server.
en.connection.status.invalid-credentials: Platform sign-in failed. Check the admin account password and sign in again.
en.connection.status.login-rate-limited: Too many platform sign-in attempts. Try signing in again later.
en.connection.status.gateway-auth-required: This address is still protected by the old site login. Ask the administrator to configure a dedicated platform route. The admin platform password is not the old site password.
en.connection.status.platform-unavailable: This address does not provide the platform sign-in API. Ask the administrator to check the service version and platform route.
en.connection.signedOutUnconfirmed: Signed out on this device. Server-side session revocation has not been confirmed.
